question: Related Questions Q. A few years back I had the privilege of attending a few lectures of Hazrat Moulana Anzar Shah Saheb (DB) in my local masjid. Since then, I have had a few dreams about him and would like to know their meanings. 1. I had a dream that Moulana Saheb (DB) was very weak and was about to break into pieces inside my local masjid and I was carrying him and trying to get help for him. Others were also trying to help, e.g. my brothers and friends but I did not let them and I said to then that they don't know how to help him and that only I could do this. 2. I had a dream that I wa following Hazrat Moulana (DB) around the UK as he was delivering various talks around the country and that I was also studying under him at the same time whilst he travelled around. 3. I had another dream about a famous Scholar in the UK. I dreamt that He was teaching (dars) in the dar ul uloom where he teaches. I dreamt that I was sitting infront of him and that he requested me to read and explain the book he was doing a dars of and I refused saying "How can I read anything in your presence" but he insisted and so I began reading the book. However, as soon as I started reading, the respected Scholar got up hastily and left the room and everyone followed him out. 1458 views Q.
